grf_collapse.observed_reality: The exact current EntityOS binary behaves correctly when DISPLAY is absent but classifies a non-empty unreachable DISPLAY as graphical availability and then fails at XOpenDisplay.
grf_collapse.preferred_hypothesis: The availability predicate is weaker than the actual X11 connection requirement: environment presence plus libX11 presence can be true while XOpenDisplay fails.
grf_collapse.strongest_counterhypothesis: The failure is an unrelated artifact/container incompatibility rather than the display-availability predicate.
grf_collapse.discriminator: Run the same binary and state protocol with only DISPLAY changed from absent to an unreachable endpoint.

code_observation.boot_entry: entityos/boot_entry.py calls entityos.visual_shell.graphical_display_available before GUI grant and product-surface selection.
code_observation.visual_shell: graphical_display_available currently checks non-empty DISPLAY plus find_library('X11'); _X11 later calls XOpenDisplay and rejects a null connection.
code_observation.upstream_semantics: X.org XOpenDisplay documentation states that XOpenDisplay establishes the X-server connection and returns NULL on failure.

test_obligation: Add a deterministic stale/unreachable DISPLAY regression gate. Graphical availability must require an actually usable display connection or the boot boundary must otherwise fall back/fail without misclassifying an unreachable display as a declined user grant.
next_executable_action: Implement a bounded XOpenDisplay connectivity probe or equivalent safe fallback in the EntityOS graphical-availability boundary, add the stale-DISPLAY regression test, then rebuild and rerun the exact one-file EntityOS canonical gates. Do not weaken host/effect authority.
